correctness.rationale: The exact Pandis projection formula and elementary simplex crossing-face identity are used with consistent dimensions. Centering N iid Gaussians produces the Haar normal; first-order expansion of the studentized absolute deviation and empirical sign imbalance gives explicitly centered even and odd influence functions. Their exact variances are \(1-3/\pi\) and \(1-2/\pi\) and covariance zero. Multivariate CLT and fixed-degree binomial expansion prove the joint independent Gaussian/chi-square limit for all fixed ranks. Spherical Gaussian moments prove the two exact finite mean formulas. A standalone verifier passed 387 finite tests as supplementary evidence, not as infinite proof.

value.rationale: Orthogonal-shadow volume and central section face counts of the very same random hyperplane are coupled nonlinearly at finite dimension. Their asymptotic independence is a structural decoupling that neither marginal result establishes. Explicit unequal fluctuation laws, variances, and finite shadow moments calibrate stochastic geometric simulations and distinguish metric from combinatorial section complexity; the object and normalizations are canonical.
